company_name: Shanxi Tiancheng Semiconductor Material Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in the production of silicon carbide single crystal materials, which are critical for advanced semiconductor applications.
summary: Shanxi Tiancheng Semiconductor Materials Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, and production of third-generation semiconductor silicon carbide single crystal materials. The company also manufactures crystal growth equipment, catering to high-frequency, high-power, and RF semiconductor applications.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shanxi, China, and focuses on advanced semiconductor material technologies.
